/* FUNCTIONALITY */

-- List of Branch 1050 (Fairview) customers
Select distinct customerid
from dw.dimcustomeraccount dca
where  dca.banksk = '1' and dca.branchsk = '50' and dca.sourcesystemcode = 'DEP'

/* ROW-LEVEL SECURITY */

Select top 10 ddc.customerid
from dw.dimcustomer ddc
left join dw.dimcustomeraccount dca
        on ddc.customersk = dca.customersk
left join dw.dimbranch ddb
        on ddb.branchsk = dca.branchsk
where ddb.branchid <> '1050'
and ddb.branchid <> '' 
and ddb.branchid is not null

/* DEMOGRAPHICS */
SELECT DISTINCT BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.CustomerId,
                DW.DimCustomer.RelationshipStartDate AS CustomerSince,
                BNKM.Sector.SectorName AS IndustryDescription,
                BNKM.Location.LocationAddressLine1,
                BNKM.Location.LocationAddressLine2,
                BNKM.City.CityName,
                BNKM.Location.LocationZipCode,
                CASE
                        WHEN BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber.PreferenceId = 'Y' THEN BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber.TelephoneNumber
                        ELSE NULL
                END AS MobileNumber,
                BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.SMEClassification,
                BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.SicIndustryCode,
                BNKM.CustomerAction.CustomerActionTimestamp,
                BNKM.CreditRisk.CreditRiskName,
                BNKM.RiskRatingType.RiskRatingTypeName,
                                CASE 
                        WHEN BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer.RelatedCustomerId IS NULL THEN 'N'
                        ELSE 'Y'
                END AS ATMIndicator,
                CASE
                        WHEN BNKM.CustomerAccount.SourceSystemCode = 'MBK' THEN 'Y'
                        ELSE 'N'
                END AS MBKIndicator,
                CASE
                        WHEN (BNKM.CustomerAccount.SourceSystemCode = 'RIB' OR BNKM.CustomerAccount.SourceSystemCode = 'BOB') THEN 'Y'
                        ELSE 'N'
                END AS EBKIndicator
FROM BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer
ON DW.DimCustomer.CustomerID = BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Sector
ON BNKM.Sector.SectorCode = BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.SectorCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerLocation
ON BNKM.CustomerLocation.CustomerId = BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Location
ON BNKM.Location.LocationId = BNKM.CustomerLocation.LocationId 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.City
ON BNKM.City.CityId = BNKM.Location.LocationCity
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber
ON BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber.CustomerId = BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.SicIndustry
ON BNKM.SicIndustry.SicIndustryCode = BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.SicIndustryCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAction
ON BNKM.CustomerAction.CustomerId = BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating
ON BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating.CustomerId = BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CreditRisk
ON BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating.CreditRiskId = BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating.CreditRiskId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.RiskRatingType
ON BNKM.RiskRatingType.RiskRatingTypeId = BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating.RiskRatingTypeId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer
ON BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer.RelatedCustomerId = BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount
ON BNKM.CustomerAccount.CustomerId = BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.CustomerId
WHERE BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.CustomerId = 'C00004138'
ORDER BY BNKM.RiskRatingType.RiskRatingTypeName, CreditRisk.CreditRiskName


SELECT DISTINCT BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.CustomerId,
                BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating.CreditRiskId,
                BNKM.RiskRatingType.RiskRatingTypeName,
                BNKM.CustomerAction.CustomerActionTimestamp
FROM BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating
ON BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating.CustomerId = BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.RiskRatingType
ON BNKM.RiskRatingType.RiskRatingTypeId = BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating.RiskRatingTypeId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAction
ON BNKM.CustomerAction.CustomerId = BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.CustomerId
WHERE BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.CustomerId = 'C00110992'

-- ATM
SELECT DISTINCT RelatedCustomerId
FROM BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer
WHERE RelatedCustomerId IN (    SELECT DISTINCT BNKM.CustomerAccount.CustomerId
                                FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount
                                LEFT JOIN BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer
                                ON BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer.CustomerId = BNKM.CustomerAccount.CustomerId)
                                -- WHERE BranchId = '1050'
ORDER BY RelatedCustomerId

-- MBK
SELECT DISTINCT BNKM.CustomerAccount.CustomerId, 
                BNKM.CustomerAccount.BranchId, 
                BNKM.CustomerAccount.SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount
WHERE BNKM.CustomerAccount.SourceSystemCode = 'MBK' 
        AND BNKM.CustomerAccount.CustomerId = 'C00035831' 

-- BOB
select distinct BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER.CIF_ID AS fcbs_customer_id, BUSC.BOB_TBLACCOUNT.[NO] AS account_number_hashed
from BUSC.BOB_TBLACCOUNT
left join BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER
on BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER.FORACID = BUSC.BOB_TBLACCOUNT.[NO]
where BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER.CIF_ID = 'C00110992'
order by BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER.CIF_ID DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ac.ORGKEY, ad.ADDRESSKEY, ad.ADDRESSCATEGORY, ad.ADDRESS_LINE1, ad.ADDRESS_LINE2, ad.ADDRESS_LINE3, ad.CITY, ad.ZIP, ad.COUNTRY, ad.START_DATE, ad.END_DATE, ad.PREFERREDADDRESS
FROM BUSC.CRM_ADDRESS as ad
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS as ac
ON ad.CORE_CUST_ID = ac.CORE_CUST_ID
WHERE ac.ORGKEY = 'C00110992'

/* MEASURES */

-- Deposit Balance
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'C00132009' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- MTD ADB
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'C00032861' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- YTD ADB
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'C00032861' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')
                        
-- Total Relationship Balance
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance
WHERE CustomerID = 'R00248275' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601'

-- Trust Fund Value
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactTrustFundValue
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'C00027660' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- Treasury Investment Value
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00248275' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- Due for the Month
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'C00032861' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- Loans Relationship Exposure
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'C00032861' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- Loan Credit Limit
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactLoansCreditLimit
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'C00006790' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- TOTAL Relationship Exposure
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactTotalRelationshipExposure
WHERE CustomerID = 'R00480392' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601'


-- Trust Fund Value in BUSC

-- uitf
SELECT DISTINCT BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY, BUSC.TRU_AUMUITF.PORTFOLIO_NO, BUSC.TRU_AUMUITF.TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP
FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS
LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_CUST
ON BUSC.TRU_CUST.UNIQUE_ID = BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY
LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_BASELINK
ON BUSC.TRU_BASELINK.CIF_NO = BUSC.TRU_CUST.CUST_NO
LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_AUMUITF
ON BUSC.TRU_AUMUITF.BASE_NO = BUSC.TRU_BASELINK.CUST_NO
WHERE BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY = 'C00027660'

-- non-uitf
SELECT DISTINCT BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY, BUSC.TRU_AUMNONUITF.PF_NO, BUSC.TRU_AUMNONUITF.AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR
FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS
LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_CUST
ON BUSC.TRU_CUST.UNIQUE_ID = BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY
LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_BASELINK
ON BUSC.TRU_BASELINK.CIF_NO = BUSC.TRU_CUST.CUST_NO
LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_AUMNONUITF
ON BUSC.TRU_AUMNONUITF.BASE_NO = BUSC.TRU_BASELINK.CUST_NO
WHERE BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY = 'C00027660'

-- LOANS: BUSC LAYER
SELECT DISTINCT gam.LIMIT_B2KID, gam.FORACID, aas.NMA_KEY_ID, aas.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE, gam.SANCT_LIM, gam.ACCT_CLS_FLG 
FROM BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN as aas -- Account authorized signatory / Co Borrower Details
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST as gam -- left joined to get Loans Credit Limit (SANCT_LIM)
ON aas.ACID = gam.ACID
WHERE aas.ACID IN (     SELECT DISTINCT aas.ACID   -- ACID should be an ACID of R00480392
                        FROM BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN as aas 
                        WHERE aas.NMA_KEY_ID = 'R00033206' )
ORDER BY gam.LIMIT_B2KID, gam.ACCT_CLS_FLG, gam.FORACID, aas.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE DESC
